items.html: Rustam Bhatti was named Canada's captain for the 2010 Under-19 World Cup in New Zealand. He scored 175 runs during the U-19 World Cup Qualifiers, including one half-century, and has gained first-class cricket experience while playing for Canada in the ICC Intercontinental Cup.
